German language skills ( native speaker or level C1 for universities ) Language of instruction German Faculty/institution School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science Stay abroad Study format Dual study optional The Master's programme in Computer Science offers further qualification for graduates holding a Bachelor’s degree in the fields of technical, applied and media computer science.               "heading": "Admission requirements",
              "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/architecture-ba/",
              "text": "General higher education entrance qualification (German Abitur), entrance qualification for studies at universities of applied sciences or placement examination/special admission Artistic-design aptitude test German language skills ( native speaker or level C1 for universities ) Language of instruction German Faculty/institution School of Architecture, Civil and Environmental Engineering Stay abroad Optional As a student enrolled on the B.A. degree programme at the HSB School of Architecture you acquire the skills and knowledge required for careers in urban planning while gaining a comprehensive insight into occupational fields related to environmental design and building construction. Working in supervised teams, you will develop projects in architecture and urban planning with a high level of practical relevance. On a broad scientific and technical basis, the strongly application-oriented studies not only provide you with basic knowledge and fundamental skills in the core areas of architecture but also develop your creative-artistic skills. The School of Architecture Bremen on Instagram The School of Architecture Bremen on LinkedIn \"einblicke\": Projects from the School of Architecture Bremen"
            },

              "heading": "Check the application deadlines and admission requirements for your desired degree programme.",
              "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/architecture-ba/",
              "text": "Questions about the degree programme can be answered by the contact persons on the degree programme pages. Advisory & Service at HSB Artistic aptitude test Detailed information on the aptitude test can be found here on this page in the section \"Artistic-creative aptitude test\". Apply Online application International applications Admission and enrolment Accepting a place and enrolling online Welcome to HSB! Information on the start of studies Artistic aptitude test Applicants must provide proof that they have passed the artistic aptitude test in accordance with the examination regulations for determining artistic aptitude for the study of architecture at HSB."
            },
            {
              "heading": "The Bachelor's degree programme in Architecture requires a special artistic aptitude and ability as a compulsory special qualitative requirement. From the begin",
              "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/architecture-ba/",
              "text": "Information about the aptitude test Admission to the bachelor's degree program in architecture requires proof of university entrance qualification as well as passing an artistic aptitude test. You should therefore register for this aptitude test in good time. The test consists of about two hours of independent work on architectural or design tasks and a subsequent discussion (about 15 minutes) with 2 - 3 lecturers. In the interview, we want to find out from you what ideas you have developed in solving the tasks, but also what fascinates you about architecture, why you want to study architecture and why you want to come to us. We would therefore like to ask you to take the whole day for us. In the artistic aptitude test we evaluate according to the following criteria: drawing ability conceptualization spatial imagination Accordingly, you will receive a small task for each of the three criteria, which will be newly conceived for each aptitude test: For example, you may be asked to translate a description of a room or place into a drawing or sketch, or to build a simple model. When working on the tasks, it is important to work precisely and to express oneself both clearly and originally in drawings and in writing. It is important to be able to depict spatially correctly, to reproduce the effect of space and materials well (incidence of light, color, haptics, acoustics, etc .) and to incorporate your own ideas and individual skills into the work. You can prepare for the tasks by constantly sketching in a sketchbook, drawing and observing, but we do not require drawing portfolios. Furthermore, we do not ask for evidence of skills in specific subjects such as mathematics, physics, or language, and of course we do not expect you to produce perfect architectural drawings, model"
            }

The School of Logopedics and the School of Physiotherapy in Bremen are allocated to the largest healthcare provider, the hospital group Gesundheit Nord (GeNo).               "text": "Language of instruction German Faculty/institution School of International Business Stay abroad Yes Study format Stay abroad The International Degree Programme Global Management B.A. (ISGM) focuses on 'emerging economies' in Latin America, Asia and Africa, of which Costa Rica, Thailand or Brazil serve as good examples. These regions are among the most economically intriguing regions in the world.             },

              "heading": "Check the application deadlines and admission requirements for your desired degree programme.",
              "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/international-degree-programme-in-global-management-ba/",
              "text": "Questions about the degree programme can be answered by the contact persons on the degree programme pages. If you have any further questions about your decision to study at HSB , our advisory and service institutions will be happy to help. Advisory & Service at HSB Apply Online application International applications Admission and enrolment Accepting a place and enrolling online Welcome to HSB! Information on the start of studies"
            },
            {
              "heading": "Further information on the admission requirements",
              "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/international-degree-programme-in-global-management-ba/",
              "text": "Proof of English language skills English language skills at level B1.2 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages are required for admission. Proof can be provided by: the successful completion of upper secondary school with the above-mentioned language as an advanced course or as a basic course with at least 7 points completion of English classes in grade 12 of the secondary school with at least the grade (3,0) completion of the Fachhochschulreife with at least the grade (3.0) in the foreign language English the submission of a recognised language test or certificate in English at the required level: a TOEFL score of at least 57 Internet-based (iBT), 163 Computer-based (CBT) 490 Paper-based (PBT) ( www.toefl.org ) an IELTS band score of at least 4.5 (www. ielts .org) the Cambridge First Certificate in English by taking a test at a recognised foreign language centre, such as the Language Centre of the Universities in the State of Bremen (FZHB). an equivalent qualification or equivalent language course A stay abroad of at least 6 months in an English-speaking country and equivalent English language skills acquired in the process. a completed professional language training in English (foreign language correspondent, etc .) English as mother tongue Submission of proof Please submit the proof of language proficiency together with the 'Application for enrolment' after successful online admission."

            {
              "heading": "Admission requirements",
              "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/cooperative-international-degree-programme-in-midwifery-bsc/",
              "text": "Higher education entrance qualification 4 weeks of practical training in a midwife's field of work (clinical or non-clinical), including at least 2 weeks in a delivery room. English language skills at level B1.2 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages. German language skills ( native speaker or level C1 for universities ) Language of instruction German Faculty/institution School of Social Sciences Stay abroad Yes Study format Stay abroad"
            },
            {
              "heading": "The International Midwifery B.Sc. degree programme ideally prepares you for the complex and at the same time dynamically changing requirements in the profession",
              "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/cooperative-international-degree-programme-in-midwifery-bsc/",
              "text": "In addition to psychosocial basics, you will also acquire fundamental knowledge of medical and health sciences, i.e. the degree programme comprehensively covers the entire spectrum of midwifery work. In addition to the acquisition of theoretical knowledge, the practical component also plays a major role: You complete practical phases with freelance midwives as well as in clinics, and at Hochschule Bremen you specifically train your practical skills under realistic conditions in the Skills and Simulation Centre. The programme enables you to independently carry out the activities required of midwives under German regulations – in particular, birth accompaniment and monitoring the course of the postpartum phase. The contents of the study programme are recognised throughout the European Union and entitle you to work as a midwife in all EU member states. The places for the practical phases are allocated by the Hochschule Bremen. Students receive an employment contract with the cooperating institution for the entire duration of the programme. Study with midwifery exam (German only)"
            },
            {
              "heading": "You are expected to bear a high level of personal responsibility in respect of meeting the programme requirements. The phases of independent learning account fo",
              "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/cooperative-international-degree-programme-in-midwifery-bsc/",
              "text": "Each module ends with a module examination. In your last semester, you work on your Bachelor thesis and the programme ends with the colloquium and award of the academic title ‘Bachelor of Science’. Furthermore, you take a written, oral and practical state examination for professional recognition as a midwife."
            },
            {
              "heading": "In order to be admitted to the examinations, you must fulfil certain requirements from the practical placements. These are regulated on the national level by ex",
              "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/cooperative-international-degree-programme-in-midwifery-bsc/",
              "text": "Module manual (German) ISHEB_Modulhandbuch-Aktualisierung_Engl.pdf (PDF, 1 MB, File does not meet accessibility standards) Examination regulations (German) BPO IS Hebammen 2020-21 (PDF, 499 KB, File does not meet accessibility standards) BPO ISHeb Änderungsordnung 2024 (PDF, 369 KB, File does not meet accessibility standards) BPO ISHeb 2025 (PDF, 439 KB, File does not meet accessibility standards) BPO IS Hebammen 2020-21 (PDF, 499 KB, File does not meet accessibility standards) BPO ISHeb Änderungsordnung 2024 (PDF, 369 KB, File does not meet accessibility standards) BPO ISHeb 2025 (PDF, 439 KB, File does not meet accessibility standards) General examination regulations for bachelor degree programmes Work placements"
            }

              "heading": "Admission requirements",
              "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/international-degree-programme-in-nursing-bsc/",
              "text": "Higher education entrance qualification English language skills at level B1.2 (can be acquired as part of the degree programme, in which case proof must be submitted by the end of the 4th semester at the latest) German language skills ( native speaker or level C1 for universities )"
            },
            {
              "heading": "Special requirements",
              "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/international-degree-programme-in-nursing-bsc/",
              "text": "Language of instruction German Faculty/institution School of Social Sciences Stay abroad Yes Study format Stay abroad The international B.Sc. programme in nursing trains you in the care of adults, children and elderly persons. Over a programme encompassing eight semesters, you acquire comprehensive skills for a wide range of applications – firm foundations in nursing science as well as practical know-how. After successfully completing the programme, you will have two qualifications: The Bachelor of Science and the state licensing examination as a nursing specialist. The Skills Lab / Simulation Centre on our health campus in Bremen is equipped with state-of-the-art technology and is unique in Germany in this form. The international degree programme in nursing at the HSB encompasses: Competences for independent and process-oriented nursing care Reflection and further development of one's own activities on an academically framed basis"
            },
            {
              "heading": "Perceiving requirements and implementing new tasks independently",
              "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/international-degree-programme-in-nursing-bsc/",
              "text": "Learning in practice at external cooperation partners (for example at clinics, nursing services or counselling centres) and in the Skills Lab / Simulation Centre Language of instruction"
            },
            {
              "heading": "Since 1 January 2024, primary qualifying nursing students have received appropriate remuneration for the duration of their studies in accordance with the Nursin",
              "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/international-degree-programme-in-nursing-bsc/",
              "text": "List of cooperation institutions (German) Need advice from the degree programme team? Click here. Practice orientation"
            },
            {
              "heading": "Special requirements",
              "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/international-degree-programme-in-nursing-bsc/",
              "text": "Recognition of prior qualifications It is possible that skills and knowledge acquired outside of higher education in the areas of languages (English), internationality and experience abroad through completed training as a health care nurse, geriatric nurse or health care nurse/children's nurse as well as professional further education and training can be credited to selected modules of the International Nursing Degree Programme. In order to check whether something can be recognised, an application for recognition must be submitted to the examination board of the degree programme. Individual study counselling is available all year round from the head of the degree programme."
            }

              "text": "Language of instruction German Faculty/institution School of International Business Stay abroad Optional A general study of business administration or a specialization in retail?               "heading": "Admission requirements",
              "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/social-work-ba/",
              "text": "Higher education entrance qualification pre-study internship (13 weeks, currently 6 weeks under Corona restrictions) good knowledge of English is desirable, but not a prerequisite. German language skills ( native speaker or level C1 for universities )"
            },
            {
              "heading": "Further detailed information on the admission requirements",
              "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/social-work-ba/",
              "text": "Language of instruction German Faculty/institution School of Social Sciences Stay abroad Do you enjoy working with people and want to make a worthwhile contribution to the society you live in? Then our Social Work B.A. degree programme is probably just right for you. The generalist orientation of the degree programme is excellent preparation for subsequent professional practice in which the increasing complexity of social problems impacts on virtually all individual fields of activity. The broadly based professional competences acquired meet the need to adopt a holistic perception of the individual addressees including their social relations and networks, while taking into account socio-spatial conditions. One of the main aims is to understand the need for flexibility in the analysis of the problems, resources and the development potential of the people you will one day be dealing with. After completing the programme, you will be able to work with individuals, families, social groups and communities on the basis of academically framed standards and professional ethics in a way that advances social development and social cohesion, while at the same time promoting people's autonomy and self-determination. The Social Work B.A. programme is characterised by a strong connection to the practice of social work in the region, which is reflected in the good cooperation with practitioners, some of whom will actually be your lecturers. Moreover, the degree is based on the professional and ethical premises of the International Federation of Social Work and maintains diverse international networks, which provide excellent sources of cooperation for placements abroad, reciprocal teaching visits and events such as the ‘International University Week’. Dual track This degree programme i"

            {
              "heading": "Admission requirements",
              "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/dual-study-programme-social-work-ba/",
              "text": "Higher education entrance qualification good knowledge of English is desirable, but not a prerequisite German language skills ( native speaker or level C1 for universities ) training or study contract with one of the partner companies Please note: The above-mentioned application period applies to online registration in the HSB application portal. The application period at the partner companies can be six months to one year before the start of the programme. Language of instruction German Faculty/institution School of Social Sciences Stay abroad Study format Dual study Do you enjoy working with people and want to make a worthwhile contribution to the society you live in? Then our dual study programme in Social Work B.A. is probably just right for you. The generalist orientation of the degree programme is excellent preparation for subsequent professional practice in which the increasing complexity of social problems impacts on virtually all individual fields of activity. The broadly based professional competences acquired meet the need to adopt a holistic perception of the individual addressees including their social relations and networks, while taking into account socio-spatial conditions. One of the main aims is to understand the need for flexibility in the analysis of the problems, resources and the development potential of the people you will one day be dealing with. After completing the programme, you will be able to work with individuals, families, social groups and communities on the basis of academically framed standards and professional ethics in a way that advances social development and social cohesion, while at the same time promoting people's autonomy and self-determination."
            },

              "heading": "Check the application deadlines and admission requirements for your desired degree programme.",

              "heading": "Admission requirements",
              "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/practice-research-and-innovation-in-social-work-ma/",
              "text": "A first professional university degree (210 ECTS or 180 ECTS plus proven post-qualification of ideally 30 ECTS, with an overall grade of at least 2.5) in an undergraduate degree programme in the subject areas of social work, social pedagogy or social management as well as at least nine months of professional experience in a field of social work, including the probationary year required for state recognition knowledge of English in order to be able to study specialist literature in the English language German language skills ( native speaker or level C1 for universities )"
            },
            {
              "heading": "Please visit the German version of the programme's website for further information on admission requirements",
              "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/practice-research-and-innovation-in-social-work-ma/",
              "text": "Language of instruction German Faculty/institution School of Social Sciences Stay abroad Modern societies are characterised by processes of social change. The institutions and organisations of the welfare state and civil society are also affected and challenged by the issues and tasks involved. Subsequent efforts to shape such processes should be knowledge-based, and their design and further development call for innovative and creative approaches in the field of social work. The Master's degree programme ‘Practice Research and Innovation in Social Work’ enables you to rethink and further develop the tasks of social work based on the findings of practice research and analysis of current innovation in the field. It also qualifies you to take on challenging tasks in later professional life – especially with regard to the conception, design and implementation of innovative approaches in practice, research, science, as well as development and management in social work. In doing so, it systematically brings together aspects of research, innovation and transformation. The protection of your data is important to us! Based on the cookie settings you have chosen, we have blocked the connection to the provider of this content. If you would like to see the content embedded here, activate the \"YouTube\" category in the cookie settings. Shaping society together"

Please see: https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/before/application-and-admission/ . The Shipping and Chartering (ISSC) international degree programme is an interdisciplinary programme combining areas of maritime economy, nautical and technology, maritime management, and maritime law. The interdisciplinary nature of the curriculum reflects the interdisciplinary nature of the maritime industry. It aims to impart fundamental and specialist knowledge as well as methodological and analytical skills to ISSC graduates, thus preparing them for executive roles in the complex, international, and interconnected world of the maritime industry. The ISSC curriculum devotes six semesters to modules covering maritime business related to subjects including maritime economics, management, accounting, ship finance and chartering, Furthermore, the curriculum ensures that ISSC graduates possess broad knowledge of laws relevant to the maritime industry: shipping law and environmental regulation, commercial law, carriage of goods by sea and transport law, charter parties, marine insurance, and maritime arbitration. These subjects are complemented by modules in the areas of ship technology, port economics, dangerous goods, safety and security as well as emergency management. Since 2019, the ISSC study programme has been part of the Blue Sciences Cooperation of Studies and Research. Through the Blue Sciences joint modules offering, ISSC students have opportunities to further strengthen their competences in the areas of blue economy, environmental aspects of marine use, intelligent maritime logistics and maritime environmental management systems. All modules are taught in English. The Bachelor's thesis is also required to be written in English. Projects with partners in Germany and abroad Academic admission requirements Academic admission requirements include one of the following classification test / special admission Language requirements Please see: https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/before/application-and-admission/ . If you earned your higher education entrance qualification abroad and meet the admission requirements and the language qualifications , first apply for the \"Vorprüfungsdokumentation\" (VPD) at uni-assist.de before applying to Bremen University of Applied Sciences (HSB) via CampInO with the VPD. Information for prospective international students: https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/before/application-and-admission/international-applications/"

              "Description/content",
              "The Shipping and Chartering (ISSC) international degree programme is an interdisciplinary programme combining areas of maritime economy, nautical and technology, maritime management, and maritime law.               "The ISSC curriculum devotes six semesters to modules covering maritime business related to subjects including maritime economics, management, accounting, ship finance and chartering, Furthermore, the curriculum ensures that ISSC graduates possess broad knowledge of laws relevant to the maritime industry: shipping law and environmental regulation, commercial law, carriage of goods by sea and transport law, charter parties, marine insurance, and maritime arbitration. These subjects are complemented by modules in the areas of ship technology, port economics, dangerous goods, safety and security as well as emergency management.",
              "The fifth semester is dedicated to a mandatory internship (practical placement period) in a maritime business or transport enterprise abroad. International students may be allowed to undertake the mandatory internship in Germany.",
              "Since 2019, the ISSC study programme has been part of the Blue Sciences Cooperation of Studies and Research. Approx. 17,900 EUR for the two Master's degrees and the entire programme (depending on partner university) Academic admission requirements Language requirements Very good English language skills are required; applicants must provide proof of English proficiency with TOEFL 90 points (iBT) or IELTS 6.5 points. https://www.graduatecenter.org/en/admission-support/online-application.html As this is a one-year full-time Master's programme, and due to the intense study period and high workload, it is not recommended to work during the course of study. (In general, students from European Union countries are not required to have a work permit to work during their course of study. Students from countries outside the European Union may work 120 full days or 240 half days over the course of one year without a work permit. A special permit is required to work more than that.) The International Graduate Center (IGC) was founded by Hochschule Bremen City University of Applied Sciences (HSB) as an interdisciplinary Graduate School for Management and Leadership. For applicants with a first university degree, the IGC offers several non-consecutive MBA and Master's degrees in the area of international and European business and management. All full-time courses are taught entirely in English."
                }

Please see: https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/before/application-and-admission/ . The Shipping and Chartering (ISSC) international degree programme is an interdisciplinary programme combining areas of maritime economy, nautical and technology, maritime management, and maritime law. The interdisciplinary nature of the curriculum reflects the interdisciplinary nature of the maritime industry. It aims to impart fundamental and specialist knowledge as well as methodological and analytical skills to ISSC graduates, thus preparing them for executive roles in the complex, international, and interconnected world of the maritime industry. The ISSC curriculum devotes six semesters to modules covering maritime business related to subjects including maritime economics, management, accounting, ship finance and chartering, Furthermore, the curriculum ensures that ISSC graduates possess broad knowledge of laws relevant to the maritime industry: shipping law and environmental regulation, commercial law, carriage of goods by sea and transport law, charter parties, marine insurance, and maritime arbitration. These subjects are complemented by modules in the areas of ship technology, port economics, dangerous goods, safety and security as well as emergency management. Since 2019, the ISSC study programme has been part of the Blue Sciences Cooperation of Studies and Research. Through the Blue Sciences joint modules offering, ISSC students have opportunities to further strengthen their competences in the areas of blue economy, environmental aspects of marine use, intelligent maritime logistics and maritime environmental management systems. All modules are taught in English. The Bachelor's thesis is also required to be written in English. Projects with partners in Germany and abroad Academic admission requirements Academic admission requirements include one of the following classification test / special admission Language requirements Please see: https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/before/application-and-admission/ . If you earned your higher education entrance qualification abroad and meet the admission requirements and the language qualifications , first apply for the \"Vorprüfungsdokumentation\" (VPD) at uni-assist.de before applying to Bremen University of Applied Sciences (HSB) via CampInO with the VPD. Information for prospective international students: https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/before/application-and-admission/international-applications/"

The School of Logopedics and the School of Physiotherapy in Bremen are allocated to the largest healthcare provider, the hospital group Gesundheit Nord (GeNo).                   "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/architecture-ba/",
                  "text": "General higher education entrance qualification (German Abitur), entrance qualification for studies at universities of applied sciences or placement examination/special admission Artistic-design aptitude test German language skills ( native speaker or level C1 for universities ) Language of instruction German Faculty/institution School of Architecture, Civil and Environmental Engineering Stay abroad Optional As a student enrolled on the B.A. degree programme at the HSB School of Architecture you acquire the skills and knowledge required for careers in urban planning while gaining a comprehensive insight into occupational fields related to environmental design and building construction. Working in supervised teams, you will develop projects in architecture and urban planning with a high level of practical relevance. Information on the start of studies Artistic aptitude test Applicants must provide proof that they have passed the artistic aptitude test in accordance with the examination regulations for determining artistic aptitude for the study of architecture at HSB."
                },
                {
                  "heading": "The Bachelor's degree programme in Architecture requires a special artistic aptitude and ability as a compulsory special qualitative requirement. From the begin",
                  "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/architecture-ba/",
                  "text": "Information about the aptitude test Admission to the bachelor's degree program in architecture requires proof of university entrance qualification as well as passing an artistic aptitude test. You should therefore register for this aptitude test in good time. The test consists of about two hours of independent work on architectural or design tasks and a subsequent discussion (about 15 minutes) with 2 - 3 lecturers. In the interview, we want to find out from you what ideas you have developed in solving the tasks, but also what fascinates you about architecture, why you want to study architecture and why you want to come to us. We would therefore like to ask you to take the whole day for us. In the artistic aptitude test we evaluate according to the following criteria: drawing ability conceptualization spatial imagination Accordingly, you will receive a small task for each of the three criteria, which will be newly conceived for each aptitude test: For example, you may be asked to translate a description of a room or place into a drawing or sketch, or to build a simple model. When working on the tasks, it is important to work precisely and to express oneself both clearly and originally in drawings and in writing. It is important to be able to depict spatially correctly, to reproduce the effect of space and materials well (incidence of light, color, haptics, acoustics, etc .) and to incorporate your own ideas and individual skills into the work. You can prepare for the tasks by constantly sketching in a sketchbook, drawing and observing, but we do not require drawing portfolios. Furthermore, we do not ask for evidence of skills in specific subjects such as mathematics, physics, or language, and of course we do not expect you to produce perfect architectural drawings, model"
                }

                  "text": "Higher education entrance qualification German language skills ( native speaker or level C1 for universities ) ILST-FO: See note below Language of instruction German Faculty/institution School of Nature and Engineering Stay abroad Are you seeking a new challenge in aviation – either as pilot or as engineer in construction and maintenance? Then the degree programme in Aviation Systems Engineering and Management at the Hochschule Bremen is just right for you. You are free to choose your dream programme from two thematic specialisations. Together with experienced and renowned partner companies, we will then train you to become a commercial aircraft pilot or maintenance engineer, depending on what you want.                   "text": "A first professionally qualifying degree with a score of at least 210 ECTS credits in the field of computer science, mathematics or other relevant fields of study (Bachelor's degree, Diplom or comparable degree from abroad) possibly also through recognition of external achievements with an average grade of ‘good’ (2.5) or ECTS Grade A to B). German language skills ( native speaker or level C1 for universities ) Language of instruction German Faculty/institution School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science Stay abroad Study format Dual study optional The Master's programme in Computer Science offers further qualification for graduates holding a Bachelor’s degree in the fields of technical, applied and media computer science. With the profile ‘Complex Software Systems’, the degree programme looks at the development of distributed application systems over the entire spectrum – from the user interface to the control of hardware and also addresses the reasons, forms and methods involved in mastering the complexity of such systems and their development."

                {
                  "heading": "Admission requirements",
                  "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/dual-study-programme-social-work-ba/",
                  "text": "Higher education entrance qualification good knowledge of English is desirable, but not a prerequisite German language skills ( native speaker or level C1 for universities ) training or study contract with one of the partner companies Please note: The above-mentioned application period applies to online registration in the HSB application portal. The application period at the partner companies can be six months to one year before the start of the programme. Language of instruction German Faculty/institution School of Social Sciences Stay abroad Study format Dual study Do you enjoy working with people and want to make a worthwhile contribution to the society you live in? Then our dual study programme in Social Work B.A. is probably just right for you. The generalist orientation of the degree programme is excellent preparation for subsequent professional practice in which the increasing complexity of social problems impacts on virtually all individual fields of activity. The broadly based professional competences acquired meet the need to adopt a holistic perception of the individual addressees including their social relations and networks, while taking into account socio-spatial conditions. One of the main aims is to understand the need for flexibility in the analysis of the problems, resources and the development potential of the people you will one day be dealing with. After completing the programme, you will be able to work with individuals, families, social groups and communities on the basis of academically framed standards and professional ethics in a way that advances social development and social cohesion, while at the same time promoting people's autonomy and self-determination."
                },

                  "text": "Language of instruction German Faculty/institution School of International Business Stay abroad Yes Study format Stay abroad The International Degree Programme Global Management B.A. (ISGM) focuses on 'emerging economies' in Latin America, Asia and Africa, of which Costa Rica, Thailand or Brazil serve as good examples.                   "heading": "Further information on the admission requirements",
                  "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/international-degree-programme-in-global-management-ba/",
                  "text": "Proof of English language skills English language skills at level B1.2 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages are required for admission. Proof can be provided by: the successful completion of upper secondary school with the above-mentioned language as an advanced course or as a basic course with at least 7 points completion of English classes in grade 12 of the secondary school with at least the grade (3,0) completion of the Fachhochschulreife with at least the grade (3.0) in the foreign language English the submission of a recognised language test or certificate in English at the required level: a TOEFL score of at least 57 Internet-based (iBT), 163 Computer-based (CBT) 490 Paper-based (PBT) ( www.toefl.org ) an IELTS band score of at least 4.5 (www. ielts .org) the Cambridge First Certificate in English by taking a test at a recognised foreign language centre, such as the Language Centre of the Universities in the State of Bremen (FZHB). an equivalent qualification or equivalent language course A stay abroad of at least 6 months in an English-speaking country and equivalent English language skills acquired in the process. a completed professional language training in English (foreign language correspondent, etc .)                 {
                  "heading": "Admission requirements",
                  "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/cooperative-international-degree-programme-in-midwifery-bsc/",
                  "text": "Higher education entrance qualification 4 weeks of practical training in a midwife's field of work (clinical or non-clinical), including at least 2 weeks in a delivery room. English language skills at level B1.2 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages. German language skills ( native speaker or level C1 for universities ) Language of instruction German Faculty/institution School of Social Sciences Stay abroad Yes Study format Stay abroad"
                },
                {
                  "heading": "The International Midwifery B.Sc. degree programme ideally prepares you for the complex and at the same time dynamically changing requirements in the profession",
                  "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/cooperative-international-degree-programme-in-midwifery-bsc/",
                  "text": "In addition to psychosocial basics, you will also acquire fundamental knowledge of medical and health sciences, i.e. the degree programme comprehensively covers the entire spectrum of midwifery work. In addition to the acquisition of theoretical knowledge, the practical component also plays a major role: You complete practical phases with freelance midwives as well as in clinics, and at Hochschule Bremen you specifically train your practical skills under realistic conditions in the Skills and Simulation Centre. The programme enables you to independently carry out the activities required of midwives under German regulations – in particular, birth accompaniment and monitoring the course of the postpartum phase. The contents of the study programme are recognised throughout the European Union and entitle you to work as a midwife in all EU member states. The places for the practical phases are allocated by the Hochschule Bremen. Students receive an employment contract with the cooperating institution for the entire duration of the programme. Study with midwifery exam (German only)"
                },
                {
                  "heading": "You are expected to bear a high level of personal responsibility in respect of meeting the programme requirements. The phases of independent learning account fo",
                  "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/cooperative-international-degree-programme-in-midwifery-bsc/",
                  "text": "Each module ends with a module examination. In your last semester, you work on your Bachelor thesis and the programme ends with the colloquium and award of the academic title ‘Bachelor of Science’. Furthermore, you take a written, oral and practical state examination for professional recognition as a midwife."
                },
                {
                  "heading": "In order to be admitted to the examinations, you must fulfil certain requirements from the practical placements. These are regulated on the national level by ex",
                  "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/cooperative-international-degree-programme-in-midwifery-bsc/",
                  "text": "Module manual (German) ISHEB_Modulhandbuch-Aktualisierung_Engl.pdf (PDF, 1 MB, File does not meet accessibility standards) Examination regulations (German) BPO IS Hebammen 2020-21 (PDF, 499 KB, File does not meet accessibility standards) BPO ISHeb Änderungsordnung 2024 (PDF, 369 KB, File does not meet accessibility standards) BPO ISHeb 2025 (PDF, 439 KB, File does not meet accessibility standards) BPO IS Hebammen 2020-21 (PDF, 499 KB, File does not meet accessibility standards) BPO ISHeb Änderungsordnung 2024 (PDF, 369 KB, File does not meet accessibility standards) BPO ISHeb 2025 (PDF, 439 KB, File does not meet accessibility standards) General examination regulations for bachelor degree programmes Work placements"
                }

                {
                  "heading": "Special requirements",
                  "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/international-degree-programme-in-nursing-bsc/",
                  "text": "Contact Overview Degree Bachelor of Science Start of study Winter semester, Summer semester Application period Winter semester 01 June until 15 July Application period Summer semester 15 December until 15 January Standard period of study 8 semesters Credits 240 Accredited Yes Admission restricted Yes"
                },
                {
                  "heading": "Admission requirements",
                  "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/international-degree-programme-in-nursing-bsc/",
                  "text": "Higher education entrance qualification English language skills at level B1.2 (can be acquired as part of the degree programme, in which case proof must be submitted by the end of the 4th semester at the latest) German language skills ( native speaker or level C1 for universities )"
                },
                {
                  "heading": "Special requirements",
                  "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/international-degree-programme-in-nursing-bsc/",
                  "text": "Language of instruction German Faculty/institution School of Social Sciences Stay abroad Yes Study format Stay abroad The international B.Sc. programme in nursing trains you in the care of adults, children and elderly persons. Over a programme encompassing eight semesters, you acquire comprehensive skills for a wide range of applications – firm foundations in nursing science as well as practical know-how. After successfully completing the programme, you will have two qualifications: The Bachelor of Science and the state licensing examination as a nursing specialist. The Skills Lab / Simulation Centre on our health campus in Bremen is equipped with state-of-the-art technology and is unique in Germany in this form. The international degree programme in nursing at the HSB encompasses: Competences for independent and process-oriented nursing care Reflection and further development of one's own activities on an academically framed basis"
                },
                {
                  "heading": "Perceiving requirements and implementing new tasks independently",
                  "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/international-degree-programme-in-nursing-bsc/",
                  "text": "Learning in practice at external cooperation partners (for example at clinics, nursing services or counselling centres) and in the Skills Lab / Simulation Centre Language of instruction"
                },
                {
                  "heading": "Since 1 January 2024, primary qualifying nursing students have received appropriate remuneration for the duration of their studies in accordance with the Nursin",
                  "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/international-degree-programme-in-nursing-bsc/",
                  "text": "List of cooperation institutions (German) Need advice from the degree programme team? Click here. Practice orientation"
                },
                {
                  "heading": "Special requirements",
                  "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/international-degree-programme-in-nursing-bsc/",
                  "text": "Recognition of prior qualifications It is possible that skills and knowledge acquired outside of higher education in the areas of languages (English), internationality and experience abroad through completed training as a health care nurse, geriatric nurse or health care nurse/children's nurse as well as professional further education and training can be credited to selected modules of the International Nursing Degree Programme. In order to check whether something can be recognised, an application for recognition must be submitted to the examination board of the degree programme. Individual study counselling is available all year round from the head of the degree programme."
                }
              ],

                {
                  "heading": "Admission requirements",
                  "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/practice-research-and-innovation-in-social-work-ma/",
                  "text": "A first professional university degree (210 ECTS or 180 ECTS plus proven post-qualification of ideally 30 ECTS, with an overall grade of at least 2.5) in an undergraduate degree programme in the subject areas of social work, social pedagogy or social management as well as at least nine months of professional experience in a field of social work, including the probationary year required for state recognition knowledge of English in order to be able to study specialist literature in the English language German language skills ( native speaker or level C1 for universities )"
                },
                {
                  "heading": "Please visit the German version of the programme's website for further information on admission requirements",
                  "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/practice-research-and-innovation-in-social-work-ma/",
                  "text": "Language of instruction German Faculty/institution School of Social Sciences Stay abroad Modern societies are characterised by processes of social change. The institutions and organisations of the welfare state and civil society are also affected and challenged by the issues and tasks involved. Subsequent efforts to shape such processes should be knowledge-based, and their design and further development call for innovative and creative approaches in the field of social work. The Master's degree programme ‘Practice Research and Innovation in Social Work’ enables you to rethink and further develop the tasks of social work based on the findings of practice research and analysis of current innovation in the field. It also qualifies you to take on challenging tasks in later professional life – especially with regard to the conception, design and implementation of innovative approaches in practice, research, science, as well as development and management in social work. In doing so, it systematically brings together aspects of research, innovation and transformation. The protection of your data is important to us! Based on the cookie settings you have chosen, we have blocked the connection to the provider of this content. If you would like to see the content embedded here, activate the \"YouTube\" category in the cookie settings. Shaping society together"

                {
                  "heading": "Admission requirements",
                  "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/social-work-ba/",
                  "text": "Higher education entrance qualification pre-study internship (13 weeks, currently 6 weeks under Corona restrictions) good knowledge of English is desirable, but not a prerequisite. German language skills ( native speaker or level C1 for universities )"
                },
                {
                  "heading": "Further detailed information on the admission requirements",
                  "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/social-work-ba/",
                  "text": "Language of instruction German Faculty/institution School of Social Sciences Stay abroad Do you enjoy working with people and want to make a worthwhile contribution to the society you live in? Then our Social Work B.A. degree programme is probably just right for you. The generalist orientation of the degree programme is excellent preparation for subsequent professional practice in which the increasing complexity of social problems impacts on virtually all individual fields of activity. The broadly based professional competences acquired meet the need to adopt a holistic perception of the individual addressees including their social relations and networks, while taking into account socio-spatial conditions. One of the main aims is to understand the need for flexibility in the analysis of the problems, resources and the development potential of the people you will one day be dealing with. After completing the programme, you will be able to work with individuals, families, social groups and communities on the basis of academically framed standards and professional ethics in a way that advances social development and social cohesion, while at the same time promoting people's autonomy and self-determination. The Social Work B.A. programme is characterised by a strong connection to the practice of social work in the region, which is reflected in the good cooperation with practitioners, some of whom will actually be your lecturers. Moreover, the degree is based on the professional and ethical premises of the International Federation of Social Work and maintains diverse international networks, which provide excellent sources of cooperation for placements abroad, reciprocal teaching visits and events such as the ‘International University Week’. Dual track This degree programme i"
                },
                {
                  "heading": "Check the application deadlines and admission requirements for your desired degree programme.",
                  "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/social-work-ba/",
                  "text": "Questions about the degree programme can be answered by the contact persons on the degree programme pages. If you have any further questions about your decision to study at HSB , our advisory and service institutions will be happy to help. Advisory & Service at HSB Apply Online application International applications Admission and enrolment Accepting a place and enrolling online Welcome to HSB! Information on the start of studies"
                },

                {
                  "heading": "An internship within the framework of grade 11 of the Fachoberschule Fachrichtung Sozialpädagogik is recognised in place of the requirement described above. How",
                  "source_url": "https://www.hs-bremen.de/en/study/degree-programme/social-work-ba/",
                  "text": "Completed vocational training in a nursing or educational profession as well as the field of speech therapy and physiotherapy or proof of a completed voluntary social year (German: Freiwilliges Soziales Jahr FSJ) can also replace the internship.
